    • components/slide-note
    • TpSlideNote

    Class TpSlideNote

    Presents collapsible speaker notes above a presentation's mode menu.

    Example

    <tp-slide-note legend="Speaker notes" lang="en-GB" show-text>
      <script type="tp/txt">Introduce the idea. [trigger=clic] Explain the next step.</script>
    </tp-slide-note>

    Tagname

    tp-slide-note

    Attr

    open = false - Expands the notes panel; closing it does not stop narration.

    Cssprop

    --tp-slide-note-width = 36rem - Maximum width of docked notes.

    Cssprop

    --tp-slide-note-gap = .5rem - Space between docked notes and the presentation menu.

    Keyboard

    Expands or collapses the focused notes summary.
